status: Read-only preliminary audit; no policy registration or implementation yet
roadmapItem: Q14b following-letter conditions for soft c/g
findings: GraphemeCondition.rightContext and notRightContext constrain next phoneme sound, not next written letter.
The condition API exposes left written context but no right written context.
The English reading table separately encodes soft c/g requiring e/i/y and hard c/g forbidding them.
The dʒ/g inventory entry uses a front-vowel phone condition; s/c includes front-vowel, ɜ and ɚ phone contexts.
The hard g/g entry has no following-context condition; gu/g uses a front-vowel phone condition.
openRequirements: Measure final-root incompatible following letters from whole owned units, separating opaque ownership and morphology-unavailable cases.
Specify joint or lookahead selection so conditioning on a future spelling does not silently substitute a phoneme proxy.
Define weighted sampling, RNG draws, fallback/search exhaustion, lexical exceptions and custom-config compatibility before implementation.
Preserve Q14a constructions and completion ownership when selecting alternatives.
Freeze observers, exact immediate control and independent recount before candidate capture.
